description: This script manages maintainers and areas for files or commits, parsing a MAINTAINERS.yml file, providing command-line subcommands for listing areas, files, and maintainers, and includes functions for matching file paths to areas based on patterns and regexes.

classes.name: Maintainers
classes.description: Represents the maintainers configuration loaded from a YAML file, providing methods to query areas by path or commit range, and command implementations for listing and counting areas and files.

classes.name: Area
classes.description: Represents an individual area in the maintainers configuration, with attributes like status, maintainers, collaborators, and methods to check if a path belongs to the area.

methods.name: _main
methods.description: Entry point when the script is executed directly, parses arguments and invokes the appropriate command function.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine which subcommand to execute.

methods.name: Maintainers.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Maintainers instance by loading the maintainers YAML file, either specified or from the top-level repository directory.

methods.name: Maintainers.path2areas
methods.description: Returns a list of Area objects that contain the given path.

methods.name: Maintainers.commits2areas
methods.description: Returns a set of Area objects affected by the given commit range.

methods.name: Maintainers._path_cmd
methods.description: Implements the 'path' subcommand to list areas for given paths.

methods.name: Maintainers._commits_cmd
methods.description: Implements the 'commits' subcommand to list areas affected by commit ranges.

methods.name: Maintainers._areas_cmd
methods.description: Implements the 'areas' subcommand to list areas and maintainers.

methods.name: Maintainers._count_cmd
methods.description: Implements the 'count' subcommand to count areas, maintainers, collaborators, and unmaintained areas.

methods.name: Maintainers._list_cmd
methods.description: Implements the 'list' subcommand to list files in areas or all files.

methods.name: Maintainers._orphaned_cmd
methods.description: Implements the 'orphaned' subcommand to list files not belonging to any area.

methods.name: Area._contains
methods.description: Checks if a given path belongs to this area based on pattern matching.
